limitations: mechanical loops are not long-video semantic benchmarks
short probes do not establish sustained capacity
no question-end annotations or guaranteed long answers
source-separated model tokens and per-stage queues remain incompletely instrumented
partial-session departure recovery not implemented in this campaign; all-session close followed by next case is observed
first input to first audio is not question-end TTFT
full-chain audio observations do not establish isolated Talker/Code2Wav capacity
independent source-separated tokens, complete input freshness and causal GPU subphases are not measured
